discovery.prioritisation: literature review for relevance to colorectal cancer

evidence_limits: The original manuscript and Figure 1A agree on the 1088 to 390 to 10 sequence.

The preserved original manuscript cites the 390-gene list as Supplementary Table 2, whereas a later manuscript version refers to Table 3. The supplied original supplement contains clinical information and primers in two tables, but no complete 390-gene list.

The historical whole-array screen and exact 390-to-10 decision rule were not independently recomputed. Literature review is reported as the original prioritisation step; a quantitative ranking rule is not documented.

Figure 1B retains the original pooled tumor and normal TCGA methylation-expression plots as supporting context. These are distinct from the tumor-only analyses in Figure 10 and are not independent tumor-only expression evidence.
